description.short: The complete business management app for barbershop and salon owners in Ghana.
description.full:
GroomLink Partners is the ultimate business management tool for barbershop and salon owners. Manage your appointments, staff, services, and grow your business all from one powerful app.

KEY FEATURES:
• Dashboard with business analytics and insights
• Manage appointments - view, confirm, and track bookings
• Add and manage services with pricing
• Manage staff schedules and assignments
• Update your salon profile and business hours
• Receive notifications for new bookings
• Track revenue and performance metrics

Take control of your barbershop business with GroomLink Partners. Streamline operations, delight customers, and grow your revenue.
